drug: Penmenvy (Meningococcal Groups A, B, C, W, and Y Vaccine)
indication: Active immunization against invasive meningococcal disease caused by serogroups A, B, C, W and Y, ages 10 through 25
headline: The FDA approved Penmenvy, GSK's 5-in-1 meningococcal (MenABCWY) vaccine, on Friday, February 14, 2025, for individuals aged 10 through 25. GSK announced it on Saturday, February 15 from London, and Monday, February 17 was a US market holiday, so February 18 is the first day GSK's US shares could trade on the news.
pdufa_note: The FDA's approval letter for BLA STN 125819/0 is dated February 14, 2025 (FDA letter). GSK's release is dated February 15, 2025 (GSK release). Run-up and decision-day figures use GSK's NYSE-listed shares.
source_label: FDA approval letter, BLA STN 125819/0, February 14, 2025
